description: This file defines the SandboxExtension class for Twig, which manages sandbox security features such as enabling/disabling sandboxing, checking security permissions on methods/properties, and enforcing sandbox constraints within Twig templates.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\SandboxExtension
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractExtension that manages sandbox security features, including enabling/disabling sandbox, checking security permissions, and integrating with Twig's security policy.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize SandboxExtension with a security policy, sandboxed state, and optional source policy.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns an array with a new SandboxTokenParser instance.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array with a new SandboxNodeVisitor instance.

methods.name: enableSandbox
methods.description: Enables sandboxing globally within the extension.

methods.name: disableSandbox
methods.description: Disables sandboxing globally within the extension.

methods.name: isSandboxed
methods.description: Checks if sandboxing is enabled either globally, on the current instance, or for a specific source.

methods.name: isSandboxedGlobally
methods.description: Returns whether sandboxing is enabled globally.

methods.name: checkSecurity
methods.description: Checks security for given tags, filters, functions, and optional source; delegates to the security policy if sandboxed.

methods.name: checkMethodAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a method is allowed on an object; throws an error if not permitted.

methods.name: checkPropertyAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a property is allowed on an object; throws an error if not permitted.

methods.name: ensureToStringAllowed
methods.description: Ensures that the object can be converted to a string, checking permissions if sandboxed.

methods.name: ensureToStringAllowedForArray
methods.description: Recursively checks that all elements in an array are allowed to be cast to string under sandbox restrictions.
